name: Kurami Ryouko
source:
The older sister of the main character, [url=/c135632/]Tomoki[/url]. She has always seen Tomoki as someone of the opposite sex, but has kept it a secret.

Although she loves her husband, her feelings for him is less to those for Tomoki.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_252.html#character]official site[/url]]
